verses.aludhu-bitaha-sayyida-l-kawni-wal-urbi-c: ʾalūdhu biṭaha sayyida l-kawni wal-ʿurbi waʾahli s-samā wal-ʾarḍi wash-sharqi wal-gharbi
bihi ʾartajī tafrīja hammī waʾaltajī ʾilayhi mina l-khaṭbi l-murawwaʿi wal-kaʾabi
takhadhtu rasūla llāhi yāsīna maljaʾī wamanjāyā min ʾamri yuhālu bihi qalbī
jadīru biʾan yaljaʾa ʾilayhi wayartajī matā nāba ʾamru mufziʿu mūjibu r-raʿbi
ḥamidtu ʾilahi l-ʿarsha jalla jalāluhu ʿalā jaʿlihi ʾiyyāyā min ʾummahi l-ḥubbi
khabaʾatu binafsī ʾan ʾaḥabba muḥammadā maḥabbaha dhāwī z-zuhri wākibaha s-suḥbi
dalāʾiluhu ʾilfu wanaqlu kitābati waḥasbuka nuṭqa llaḥmi war-rīmi wiḍ-ḍabi
walawlāka lam yakhruj mina l-ḥūti yūnusu mina n-nāri ʾibrāhīmu ʾaw yūsufu l-jubbi
waʾadraka nūḥā fī s-safīnati jāhahu waʾayyūbu fī balwā wayaʿqūbu fī l-karbi
